translation_snapshot.source: A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use.
translation_snapshot.target: 远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。

translation_snapshot.source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go to the west, to Charred Scar. A fiery volcano that can only spell death...
translation_snapshot.target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你不知道这道门是否为双向的。
这道门似乎通向西方，通向灼烧之痕——一个能带来死亡的活火山……

translation_snapshot.source: #GOLD#You hastily activate your Rod of Recall, vowing to come back later!
translation_snapshot.target: #GOLD#你匆忙启动了回归之杖，发誓日后再回来！
